Le secteur des télécommunications algéri: Algeria's telecommunications sector is shifting into high gear regarding customer service. Mr. Sid Ali Zerrouki, Minister of Post and Telecommunications, paid an inspection visit to Algérie Télécom's call center, in the presence of the CEO of the public company. The objective was to assess on-site the quality of subscriber support, as the deployment of fiber optics accelerates across the entire national territory.
Un engagement fort : attendre une minute: A strong commitment: waiting a maximum of one minute
Le ministre a été très clair sur la néce: The minister was very clear on the need to raise the level of service. He gave strict instructions to guarantee optimal handling of citizens' concerns, with a key indicator: reducing waiting time in telephone support.
Actuellement établi à quatre (04) minute: Currently set at four (04) minutes, this timeframe must be reduced to a maximum of one (01) minute. "This measure aims to improve the user experience and strengthen citizens' trust in digital public services," the minister stressed.
Cette refonte des centres d'appels s'ins: This overhaul of call centers is part of a territorial development logic. Mr. Zerrouki recalled that the national effort relies on the call center deployment plan across all wilayas. The example of the shared contact center recently inaugurated in Ouargla is emblematic: this facility has already created new local jobs.
Sur ce modèle, le ministère annonce le l: Building on this model, the ministry announces the launch of similar projects in several interior wilayas of the country, with a dual objective:
1-Désenclaver numériquement les régions: 1-Digitally open up remote regions; 2-Expand employment opportunities via qualified positions close to population pools.

Au-delà de l'amélioration du service pub: Beyond improving public service, this strategy addresses a major economic objective. By professionalizing its call centers to international standards, Algeria intends to position itself on the regional and global contact center services market.
« L'enjeu est de permettre à l'Algérie d: "The challenge is to enable Algeria to open up to this market, to generate foreign currency revenues, while offering stable jobs to youth in various regions of the country," the minister explained. With this roadmap, the call center ceases to be a simple cost center and becomes a true service export product.
